READING FRAMEWORK | Levels, time and evidence
|
|-- Levels: G1 thesis; G2 value engine; G3 strategic domain;
|           G4 capability; G5 dated initiative; G6 evidence.
|
|-- Time axis
|   |-- Expand: 2018-Q1 2020; Surge: Q2 2020-Q1 2021.
|   |-- Build-ahead: Q2 2021-Q2 2022.
|   |-- Reckoning: Q3 2022-Q2 2023.
|   |-- Focused compounding: Q3 2023-Q1 2025.
|   `-- Reacceleration: Q2 2025 onward.
|
|-- Evidence tags
|   |-- [R] Filing fact or arithmetic directly from filing figures.
|   |-- [S] Management statement; not independently verified.
|   |-- [I] Interpretation, assumption or evidence limitation.
|   `-- [X] Claim contradicted by the supplied corpus.
|
|-- Relationship grades
|   |-- mech: definitional/arithmetic; assoc: observed relationship.
|   |-- data: management figure; claim: asserted relationship.
|   |-- contra: contradiction; untestable: necessary evidence absent.
|   `-- causal: controlled evidence; none established here.
|
`-- Scope conventions
    |-- seed-only: inherited detail not checked by pinned excerpts.
    |-- Structural edges mean detail or membership, not causation.
    `-- NA = North America; bp = basis points; YoY = year over year.
